predictions.selection_reason: Generates a random UID used to make regexp pattern harder to guess, influencing security of placeholder replacement.
predictions.source_summary: Randomly generated numeric value converted to hexadecimal string
predictions.sink_summary: Used to construct PLACE_HOLDER_REGEXP pattern for function and regexp placeholder replacement in JSON serialization
predictions.guard_summary: UID makes placeholder pattern unpredictable, preventing conflicts with user data that might contain similar patterns
predictions.risk_pattern: Random UID generation creates unique placeholder patterns to prevent accidental matching of user-provided strings during function/regexp serialization
predictions.context_summary: UID is generated once at module load time and used to create a unique regex pattern for identifying function and regexp placeholders during serialization

top_sast_rules.description: This reports the external APIs that are used with untrusted data, along with how frequently the API is called, and how many unique sources of untrusted data flow to it.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement strict input validation using allowlists and reject invalid input rather than attempting to sanitize it.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
top_sast_rules.description: Some mathematical operations on random numbers can cause bias in the results and compromise security.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Identify usage of weak or deprecated cryptographic algorithms and practices
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use modern cryptographic algorithms and proper key management. Avoid deprecated algorithms and implement proper random number generation.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)
top_sast_rules.description: Using a cryptographically weak pseudo-random number generator to generate a security-sensitive value may allow an attacker to predict what value will be generated.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use cryptographically secure random number generators (SecureRandom, os.urandom, crypto.getRandomValues) instead of predictable PRNGs.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
